parent_objective: design source-to-intervention materialization from the four-wheel source corpus
blocked_by: M1275 promotes the fidelity source branch to source-to-intervention/materialization
supersedes: direct actor/Gym integration from M1273 source corpus

public_gates: M1276 must preserve actor input contract
M1276 must not use private holdout
M1276 must design source-to-intervention artifacts before implementation
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add per-wheel/fault labels to actor inputs
do not count source rows as driver performance
do not claim high-fidelity validation from the compact pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs how to turn M1273 source-corpus rows into intervention/replay artifacts without actor-input leakage
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization requires fault labels in actor observations
stop if materialization weakens source acceptance semantics
stop if the design skips directly to PPO or actor training
fallback_plan: if direct intervention materialization is not possible, route to source-corpus repair or boundary retargeting
if artifacts can be defined cleanly, admit one bounded no-training implementation

allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next implementation manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1276 designs source artifacts and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until no-training intervention artifacts are implemented and audited
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If source-to-intervention materialization cannot be defined cleanly, route to source-corpus repair or boundary retargeting rather than actor training.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A no-training source-to-intervention design can convert M1273 source-corpus rows into preferred/rejected counterfactual artifacts without actor-input leakage.
success_criteria: design preserves actor-input and source-acceptance guardrails
design pre-registers one bounded implementation if admitted
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design leaks fault/per-wheel metadata into actor observations
design treats source rows as driver performance
design skips directly to actor/Gym integration
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1276 passes if it designs source-to-intervention materialization and the next bounded implementation without training or actor-input expansion.
